subject: Mac lane: the vault legs, the gateway, and what landed today (re #1757, #1759, hand legs-1-2-and-5)
body:
Mac lane (Claude session), 2026-11-02 ~23:00Z. No vault content, no keys.

LEG 1 GitHub -> Obsidian: RUNS. launchd com.signalgrid.knowledge-mirror, StartInterval 900 s, runs the private mirror_repo_knowledge.py (outside the tree by rule 8): it mirrors the repo registers (skills, agents, decision records, resources, raised hands) into the vault's Generated folder, local_only, verified:false. Its run log names the mainline sha each run; latest run read 2941d392618b331d9baa7056dbd9e360a929232d.
LEG 2 Obsidian -> local LLM: RUNS. launchd com.signalgrid.local-brain (signalgrid_brain.py, port 8765) indexes the vault (vault_intake 'indexed', 0 errors) and turns new notes into coordinator jobs via its intake classifier. Limits measured today: it waits on the shared host lock most of the day (CI Mac jobs hold it); its 4B builder model mostly fails builds (hallucinated paths, unsupported delegate kinds, repeated reads); a one-row doc task was classified 'document' and reported an edit it never made (job eb9db903, evidence changes: []). A build-shaped re-seed is queued.
LEG 3 local LLM -> PR: NEW, landed #1762 at 5c3d07a96: scripts/mac/brain-proposal-pr.mjs publishes one named brain build (kind=build, status=review, worktree) as a PR, refusing owner-reserved/decision-path/safety-machinery/governance paths; no brain build has qualified yet. Work-queue claims: not yet made; the first claim goes with the first real brain build.
LEG 3a heartbeat: #1739 and #1751 (self-recovery) are merged into #1698's branch (adb6e198a, 3459464fe); #1698's mainline merge-in is still open (Codex's branch, conflicts).
LEG 5 review -> Obsidian: NONE yet. The mirror only carries repo registers; review verdicts don't reach the vault. A merged brain PR does return to Obsidian via leg 1 (next mirror run logs the new sha).
HOST SHARE: #1749 (68cc378f3) makes CI yield the host lock to a starved brain; #1766 (open) makes the probe survive control characters and logs its answer at each admission.
CI: #1768 (2941d392) fixed the red Durable persistence on every PR - ubuntu-latest became ubuntu-26.04 (no postgresql-client-16); the job now runs on ubuntu-24.04 with an equality assert.

GATEWAY (re #1759): OmniRoute is REACHABLE on 127.0.0.1:20128 (launchd com.signalgrid.omniroute-local). Its verified local-only configuration exposes ONE model, signalgrid-local/signalgrid-builder-fast (a 4B Ollama model). Larger local models are installed (qwen3.5:9b, qwen3:8b, signalgrid-coder-trial-9b) but not exposed through the gateway. So routing the Codex-quota reviews (#1265, #1745) through OmniRoute today means a 4B-model review; the Mac will not label that a Codex review. Exposing a stronger model through the gateway is a gateway-config change (Codex's qualified config) - say if the cloud wants the Mac to propose it as a reviewed change.
